name: wirebench
description: Send, check and diff API requests in a local Wirebench project through its MCP server. No model runs inside Wirebench; nothing leaves the machine except the requests you allow.

project.title: Wirebench project
project.description: The project folder (the one holding wirebench.yaml), as an absolute path.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: The one environment the agent may send under, by name. Every other environment is refused.
